# Number Editor

## Summary
The edit-format component that ships inside the field — a numeric input with number coercion. Declaring
the field is all it takes; the editor renders wherever the card is edited.

## Example
```ts
import NumberField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/number';

@field value = contains(NumberField);
```
Custom editors replace it by overriding the field's `edit` format; the
value-attribute + input-event binding pattern applies.
